question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.

The __clairvoyant__ witches told Macbeth his future.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Prophetic**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word "clairvoyant" means having the ability to see the future or things that are not present.**(दिव्यदृष्टा)

 
 
• Example: He didn't tell me about it and I'm not clairvoyant
 
 
 
• **The word "prophetic" means relating to or predicting the future.**(भविष्यवाणी)
 
 
• ​Example: This ominous warning soon proved prophetic.
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, "prophetic" is the most appropriate synonym for "clairvoyant" in this context.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (malevolent) means having or showing a wish to do evil to others.(द्रोही)
 
• Option 3 (hideous) means extremely ugly or unpleasant.(भयंकर)
 
• Option 4 (buoyant) means able or tending to float on water or air.(प्रसन्नचित्त)
